name: China Film Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Film Co.,Ltd. operates as a significant entity within the global entertainment industry, specializing in the entire lifecycle of cinematic and television productions, from initial creation and worldwide distribution to strategic marketing and ongoing support services. Beyond its core content activities, the company also engages in the manufacturing, sale, and rental of specialized equipment and vehicles for film and television. It offers a comprehensive array of ancillary services, including set design, post-production for film and TV projects, technical consulting, development of new media formats, film processing, talent representation, advertising solutions, and international trade operations. Furthermore, China Film Co.,Ltd. holds investments in, operates, and manages motion picture theaters, and is involved in the retail of lottery tickets. Established in Beijing, China, in 2010, the company functions as a subsidiary of the prominent China Film Group Corporation.
